advancements.linkle_companion.root.title: Linkle Companion
dialogue.linkle_companion.arrows.2: Arrows! You always know what I need.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_badlands: Red rocks everywhere. It's like walking on a sunset.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_beach.1: A beach! Five minutes of rest? No? Okay.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_cave.1: Dark and echoey... hello? Hello? Hello?
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_desert.1: So hot! My boots are full of sand already.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_end.1: So quiet... and so many eyes watching.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_forest.1: Trees everywhere... perfect for getting lost.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_forest.2: I like it here. Smells like pine and adventure.
Ooh, somewhere new! Which way is north again?
Never been here before. I think.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_jungle.1: Vines, vines, vines. Watch your step!
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_jungle.2: It's so loud here! Birds? Bugs? Both?
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_mountain: What a view! Let's not fall off, though.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_mushroom: Giant mushrooms?! This place is wonderful.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_nether.1: It's so hot here, even my crossbows are sweating.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_nether.2: Everything here wants to bite us. Stay sharp!
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_ocean.2: Do crossbows work underwater? Let's not find out.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_plains.1: Open fields! Easy to spot trouble from here.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_snowy.1: Brrr! I should have packed a scarf.
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_snowy.2: Snow! Race you to the next hill!
dialogue.linkle_companion.biome_swamp.1: Eww, squishy. Don't step in the dark puddles.
dialogue.linkle_companion.fight_won.1: Ha! Did you see that? Two crossbows, zero problems.
dialogue.linkle_companion.fight_won.2: Phew. That was a real fight!
dialogue.linkle_companion.fight_won.3: All clear! Anyone else want a turn?
dialogue.linkle_companion.fight_won.4: Nice teamwork! We make a good pair.
dialogue.linkle_companion.gift.3: Food! My favorite kind of present.
dialogue.linkle_companion.gift_saved.1: I'm full, but I'll save it for later!
dialogue.linkle_companion.gift_saved.2: Into the pocket it goes. Thanks!
dialogue.linkle_companion.greeting.1: Ready when you are! Lead the way.
dialogue.linkle_companion.greeting.2: Two crossbows, one adventure. Let's go!
dialogue.linkle_companion.greeting.3: I'm here! I only got lost twice on the way.
dialogue.linkle_companion.idle.1: Have you ever counted how many arrows a skeleton carries?
dialogue.linkle_companion.idle.2: I'm not lost. I'm exploring with style.
dialogue.linkle_companion.idle.3: My crossbows are clean, loaded and ready. Just saying.
dialogue.linkle_companion.idle.4: Snack break soon? Asking for a friend. The friend is me.
dialogue.linkle_companion.knocked_out.3: Ow. Remind me not to do that again...
dialogue.linkle_companion.low_health.1: Ow! I could use a breather...
dialogue.linkle_companion.low_health.2: That one hurt! Got anything to eat?
dialogue.linkle_companion.night.1: Sun's going down. Stay close, okay?
dialogue.linkle_companion.night.2: Night already? I'll keep my bolts ready.
dialogue.linkle_companion.night.3: Monsters love the dark. Good thing I love target practice.
dialogue.linkle_companion.night.4: Stars are out. Pretty... but watch the shadows.
dialogue.linkle_companion.out_of_ammo.1: I'm out of arrows! Toss me some?
dialogue.linkle_companion.owner_hurt.1: You're hurt! Fall back, I'll cover you!
dialogue.linkle_companion.owner_hurt.2: Careful! Eat something, I've got your back.
dialogue.linkle_companion.recall.1: Coming, coming! Was I lost? ...Maybe a little.
dialogue.linkle_companion.recall.2: You called? I was definitely not going the wrong way.
dialogue.linkle_companion.revived.2: Back on my feet! Thanks for waiting.
hud.linkle_companion.name: Linkle
message.linkle_companion.dismissed: Linkle waves goodbye. Her items were dropped where she stood.
message.linkle_companion.elsewhere: Your Linkle is somewhere far away (her area isn't loaded). Sneak and use the Wanderer's Compass to call a new Linkle; the old one will leave.
message.linkle_companion.failed: Linkle could not be summoned here.
message.linkle_companion.info: Linkle - mode: %s, health: %s/%s, arrows: %s, at %s %s %s in %s, skin: %s
message.linkle_companion.info_knocked_ou: She is knocked out and gets up in %s seconds (or feed her).
message.linkle_companion.knocked_out_hin: Linkle is knocked out. Give her some food to wake her up!
message.linkle_companion.none: You don't have a Linkle yet. Craft a Wanderer's Compass to summon her.
message.linkle_companion.not_yours: This Linkle travels with someone else.
message.linkle_companion.recalled: Linkle is back at your side.
message.linkle_companion.unknown_mode: Unknown mode. Use follow, stay or guard.
message.linkle_companion.unknown_skin: Unknown skin. Use classic, crimson, azure, violet, snow or custom.
